title: PROVISIONAL ESTIMATES OF INDEX OF CORE INDUSTRIES FOR THE MONTH OF JULY 2026, AND FINAL INDEX FOR THE MONTH OF JUNE 2026 WITH BASE YEAR 2022-23
subtitle: Provisional Estimates of Index of Core Industries for the month of July 2026 (Base Year 2022-23)
body_text:
Key highlights of ICI for the month of July 2026
The Index of Core Industries (ICI) grew by 5.4 per cent in July 2026 (Provisional Estimate) on a year-on-year basis, compared with July 2025 . This is slightly less than the growth rate of 6.0 per cent recorded in June 2026 (Final Index). Iron Ore, Cement, Electricity, Coal, Steel, and Refinery Products observed (Y-o-Y) growth rate of 29.5 per cent, 13.1 per cent, 9 per cent, 7.6 per cent, 2.9 per cent, and 2.7 per cent, respectively, whereas Natural Gas, Crude Oil, and Fertilizers witnessed negative growth in July 2026. Iron Ore, Electricity, and Cement have been the major drivers of overall growth of ICI during recent months. Cumulative growth rate of ICI during April-July 2026 was 4.3 per cent (Provisional Estimate) compared to 1.5 per cent in the corresponding period of the previous year. The charts (1 to 4) below show trend in ICI and its growth rate for the last 13 months, industry-wise indices and growth rates for June and July 2026, and sector-wise contribution to overall ICI growth in July 2026.

The final index for the month of June 2026 has been revised from 119.6 (Provisional Estimate) to 120.7. Accordingly, YoY growth rate has been revised from 5.0 per cent to 6.0 per cent. Index of Core Industries, and Year-on-Year (YoY) growth rate for the last 13 months is given at Annexure-I and Annexure-II. ICI for the months of April 2023 onward have been placed on the web portal of OEA at web link ( https://eaindustry.nic.in/ici_download_data.asp ). Annual and Cumulative Index and YoY growth rate is given at Annexure-III and Annexure-IV. Release Schedule : Provisional index of ICI for a reference month will be released on the 20th of the following month (if it is a working day, else on next working day). Accordingly, The ICI for the month of August 2026 will be released on Monday, 21 st September 2026.

enrichment.summary: The Index of Core Industries (ICI) grew 5.4% year-on-year in July 2026 (provisional), slower than the revised 6.0% growth in June 2026. Iron Ore (29.5%), Cement (13.1%), Electricity (9%), Coal (7.6%), Steel (2.9%) and Refinery Products (2.7%) drove growth, while Natural Gas, Crude Oil, and Fertilizers contracted. Cumulative growth for April-July 2026 stood at 4.3%, up from 1.5% in the same period last year.
enrichment.context:
The Index of Core Industries measures the combined and individual performance of eight core sectors — Coal, Crude Oil, Natural Gas, Refinery Products, Fertilizers, Steel, Cement, and Electricity — which together constitute about 40.27% of the weight in the Index of Industrial Production (IIP). Released monthly by the Office of the Economic Adviser under the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (Ministry of Commerce & Industry), ICI serves as a key leading indicator of industrial activity and overall economic momentum, feeding into GDP growth assessments ahead of the full IIP release. The base year was recently updated to 2022-23, aligning it with revised national accounts methodology.

Such monthly core sector data releases are routine but cumulatively important for tracking economic trends—sustained divergence between infrastructure sectors (like electricity and cement, linked to construction and real estate activity) versus energy sectors (crude oil, natural gas, fertilizers showing contraction) can signal structural shifts, such as slowing fertilizer demand or dependence on energy imports. Analysts and policymakers use these figures to anticipate the trajectory of aggregate industrial output and to calibrate monetary and fiscal responses.
